name: Chicken Caesar Salad "Wraps" with Strawberries & Lime Yogurt Dip
ingredients: 1 (30 oz) whole chicken rotisserie chicken, white and dark meat
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim and halve strawberries; place on a plate and set aside.
Zest and juice lime into a small bowl; add yogurt and honey. Whisk to combine the dip and set aside.
Halve tomatoes and place in a medium bowl.
Place chicken on a cutting board and, using your hands, remove meat from the skin and bones. Separate the meat into shred-like pieces, and add to the bowl with the tomatoes.
Add dressing to the bowl and stir to combine the chicken salad filling.
Trim off and discard root ends of the romaine hearts; separate the leaves to use as "wraps" and divide between plates.
Divide chicken filling between the romaine leaves and sprinkle with Parmesan. Serve with strawberries and dip on the side. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
